description: This file defines a Spring service handler class 'WaiveClientChargeCommandHandler' which processes commands to waive charges on clients within the Fineract platform. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface, uses dependency injection to access the 'ClientChargeWritePlatformService', and contains a method to handle command processing.

classes.name: WaiveClientChargeCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles commands to waive client charges, implementing the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface and using dependency injection for the service layer.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Handles the command to waive a charge by invoking the write platform service.
